newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma softer, bonds well bid, depos hold.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma softer, bonds well bid, depos hold.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were little changed in early trade, bonds were well bid and ecu/drachma was easier, dealers said.
"Ecu is lower against the drachma in early dealings," said a forex trader at a foreign bank. "We are working with three-day valeur and we might see some ecu selling for drachmas from abroad today."
Dealers said ecu/drachma was capped at 310 and could ease further later on.
Depos and forex forwards were holding late Monday levels in thin trade, traders said.
Bonds were well bid and the market was awaiting to hear more about the issuance of CPI indexed bonds this month and an auction of other government debt, bonds traders said.
"The market is awaiting to hear more about the issuance of CPI indexed bonds and the auction of other government securities," said a bond dealer at a foreign bank. "Bonds are well bid."
The finance ministry has announced that it will issue CPI-indexed bonds in May.
The mark was quoted at 158.88/93 from Monday's 158.900 fix, the dollar at 274.70/80 drachmas from 274.500 and the ecu at 309.85/90 from 309.970 drachmas.
